items.title: Six Ukrainian energy sites hit by Russia since Trump announced ceasefire, Zelensky says
items.description: Despite the US president announcing energy infrastructure would not be targeted strikes have continued, Ukraine says.

items.title: Why Moscow is staying tight-lipped on Trump's energy ceasefire
items.description: While Ukraine's Volodymyr Zelensky suggests he would sign up to a ceasefire on energy infrastructure, Russia has said little.

items.title: Documents falsified to evade tax on Abramovich's wealth, BBC finds
items.description: Backdated paperwork also made the Russian oligarch’s yachts and mansions disappear from accounts, investigation finds.

items.title: Saudi minister vows 'serious response' to Houthi attacks on airports
items.description: It comes after the armed group hit Riyadh's international airport and another facility, killing 13 people, in a significant escalation.

items.title: Breaking Bad actor RJ Mitte dies aged 34
items.description: Mitte, who lived with cerebral palsy, starred as Walter White Jr in the Emmy-winning drama series.

items.title: South Africa's deputy police chief resigns after being charged with sexual offences
items.description: Shadrack Sibiya had denied grooming a 16-year-old and raping an 18-year-old.

items.title: Immigration agents search congresswoman Ilhan Omar's home
items.description: Omar, an outspoken Trump critic, said the search was "an attempt to target political enemies" and she "will not be silenced".

items.title: Fridges in French supermarkets hit by cyber attack
items.description: Hundreds of stores were targeted by the overnight hack, which spoiled fresh and frozen food estimated to be worth millions of euros.

items.title: Qantas flight grounded after bedbug outbreak
items.description: The flight from Italy to Australia was cancelled after passengers on the plane's previous journey complained of bug bites.

items.title: Tom Cruise film Digger forecast to become one of Hollywood's biggest flops
items.description: The film dropped by around 60% in its second weekend, and could become one of Hollywood's biggest flops.

items.title: US detains man accused in multi-billion Venezuelan money laundering scheme
items.description: US officials had been offering a reward of $10m (£7.5m) for information leading to Álvaro Pulido's arrest.

items.title: Trump faces growing backlash over plans to import diesel from Russia
items.description: Both Republican and Democratic lawmakers have criticised the deal, which was announced weeks before the US midterm elections.
